answer: Your ex-spouse has to sign as a co-owner, unless your divorce decree awards the car to you. In that case, bring a certified copy of the decree and your ex's signature isn't needed. Because your name changed, also bring the document that shows the change, such as the divorce decree or a court order, and sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at the appointment.
